Greetings visitors! Welcome to my personal website. This site will serve as a platform to showcase my work, share my experiences, and provide information about myself. I am a Mapping Surveyor at Badan Informasi Geospasial (Geospatial Information Agency) in Indonesia, and I have a passion for geospatial data and mapping technologies.

To learn more about Quarto websites visit <https://quarto.org/docs/websites>.
